notes.title: New Weapons, Throwable Objects, and Deadly Traps
notes.content:
[p]In [b]Forks & Daggers[/b], the new [b]environment interaction system[/b] lets players use the manor itself as a weapon.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Throw Anything[/b]
Grab a bottle, candle, fish, goblet, or even a chicken and throw it at another player. Almost every object can now be used against your rivals. If you can pick it up, you can throw it.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Improvised Weapons[/b]
Not every fight needs a sword. A frying pan or a sturdy stick can be just as effective. Keep your weapons in your inventory and use them when chaos breaks out.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Armed Traps[/b]
The manor is full of dangers. Trigger hidden mechanisms, drop a heavy bell at the right moment, or lead your enemies into traps. Sometimes the environment is deadlier than the assassins.

Watch here new features![/p][previewyoutube="kgOpPLYeOlk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]This update turns the banquet hall into a battlefield of creativity (with a little bit of comedy). Every object you see could protect you or destroy you.

Add [b]Forks & Daggers[/b] to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b] today and get ready for the most dangerous dinner party.[/p]
